title: Therapeutic potential of isobavachalcone, a natural flavonoid, in murine experimental colitis by inhibiting NF-kappaB p65.
authors: Zhou, Yishan; Zhong, Bingling; Min, Xiangjing; Hou, Ying; Lin, Ligen; Wu, Qin; Shi, Jingshan; Chen, Xiuping
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然黄酮类化合物IBC通过抑制NF-kappaB p65缓解小鼠结肠炎，仅含少量分子对接分析p65-p50与配体结合，非TF-DNA互作核心体系，方法以湿实验为主，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: The incidence of ulcerative colitis (UC), one of the two types of inflammatory bowel disease, is increasing in many countries. Various natural products have been demonstrated with therapeutic potentials for UC. Herein, the therapeutic effects and mechanisms of isobavachalcone (IBC), a natural chalcone, were evaluated in dextran sulfate sodium (DSS)-induced colitis mice and lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-stimulated RAW264.7 macrophages. The results demonstrated that IBC treatment significantly improved the clinical symptoms, assessed by the disease activity index (DAI) scores and the histological changes of the colon. The levels of myeloperoxidase (MPO), TNF-alpha, IL-6, IL-1beta, and prostaglandin E2 (PGE2) in colon tissues were suppressed by IBC. The upregulation of inducible nitric oxide synthase (iNOS), cyclooxygenase-2 (COX-2), and NF-kappaB p65 in colon tissues were reversed by IBC as well. Furthermore, IBC significantly inhibited LPS-triggered secretion of TNF-alpha, IL-6, and nitrite, and nuclear translocation of NF-kappaB p65, in RAW264.7 cells. The luciferase reporter assay indicated that IBC significantly inhibited LPS-triggered transcription of toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4). Molecular docking results showed that the binding pocket of IBC was adjacent to Ser276 of p65-p50 heterodimer and IBC could form H-bond with Thr191. Collectively, these results demonstrated that IBC ameliorated colitis in mice possibly through inhibition of NF-kappaB p65.
abstract_zh: 溃疡性结肠炎（ulcerative colitis, UC）是炎症性肠病的两种类型之一，其发病率在许多国家呈上升趋势。多种天然产物已被证明具有治疗UC的潜力。本研究评估了天然查尔酮异补骨脂查尔酮（isobavachalcone, IBC）在葡聚糖硫酸钠（dextran sulfate sodium, DSS）诱导的结肠炎小鼠及脂多糖（lipopolysaccharide, LPS）刺激的RAW264.7巨噬细胞中的治疗效果及其机制。结果表明，IBC治疗显著改善了临床症状，通过疾病活动指数（disease activity index, DAI）评分及结肠组织学变化进行评估。结肠组织中髓过氧化物酶（myeloperoxidase, MPO）、TNF-α、IL-6、IL-1β及前列腺素E2（prostaglandin E2, PGE2）的水平被IBC抑制。IBC还逆转了结肠组织中诱导型一氧化氮合酶（inducible nitric oxide synthase, iNOS）、环氧化酶-2（cyclooxygenase-2, COX-2）及NF-κB p65的上调。此外，IBC显著抑制了LPS诱导的RAW264.7细胞中TNF-α、IL-6及亚硝酸盐的分泌，以及NF-κB p65的核转位。荧光素酶报告基因实验表明，IBC显著抑制了LPS诱导的Toll样受体4（toll-like receptor 4, TLR4）转录。分子对接结果显示，IBC的结合口袋邻近p65-p50异二聚体的Ser276，且IBC能与Thr191形成氢键。综合这些结果，IBC可能通过抑制NF-κB p65改善小鼠结肠炎。
